en.headline: Victoria Park Mid-Autumn lantern displays extended to 4 October
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said strong visitor numbers prompted a one-week extension, with lighting hours also lengthened to midnight from 24 to 27 September.
body: The Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park will run until 4 October after the Leisure and Cultural Services Department announced a one-week extension on Wednesday, citing large crowds and strong public response.

Lighting hours in the park will be extended until midnight from 24 to 27 September. The carnival, themed “A Delightful Journey through the Lantern Garden”, features displays of local delicacies, heart-shaped arches showing everyday Hong Kong scenes, and intangible cultural heritage paper-crafting lanterns, including rabbits embracing a giant moon.

A large-scale Qinhuai lantern from Nanjing titled “Shadowlight”, presented by the Hong Kong Tourism Board, is also on show. The department said the carnival includes a Mid-Autumn creative market, fire dragon dance broadcasts, traditional handicraft demonstrations and self-service lantern riddles. Admission remains free.
The department advised visitors to check the latest arrangements and plan journeys in advance, noting that crowd-control measures may be applied if needed.

zh.headline: 維園中秋綵燈會延至10月4日 24至27日亮燈至午夜
zh.dek: 康文署指入場人數眾多、反應熱烈，決定將展期延長一星期，並於9月24至27日將亮燈時間延至午夜12時。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周三宣布，鑑於參觀人數眾多及公眾反應熱烈，維多利亞公園中秋綵燈會展期延長一星期至10月4日。
公園內綵燈亮燈時間亦會於9月24至27日延長至午夜12時。今年綵燈會以「燈影漫遊樂滿城」為主題，展出本地美食花燈、心形拱門及反映香港日常生活場景的展品，另有非物質文化遺產紙紮花燈，包括兔子擁月等作品。
由香港旅遊發展局呈獻、來自南京的大型秦淮花燈「影光」亦在場展出。署方表示，綵燈會期間設有中秋創意市集、火龍舞直播、傳統手工藝示範及自助燈謎等活動，免費入場。
署方提醒市民留意最新安排及預先計劃行程，如有需要現場或會實施人流管制措施。
